example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ছোট নজরের কারণে কখনো কাউকে সাহায্য করে না।
এই ছোট নজরের মানুষের সাথে ব্যবসা করা কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his small eye, he never helps anyone.
It's hard to do business with someone who has a small eye.
note: The idiom metaphorically suggests a narrow or limited gaze, implying unwillingness to share or give generously.
